title: Museum Dino March
hook: Dinosaur, fossil, pterosaur, marine reptile—labels matter.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of quiet before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D dinosaur museum storybook, polished exhibits and signs without readable text, warm gallery light, isolated subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading museum taxonomy labels
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written classification label plus distinguishing feature
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: label cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/sort gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a clock-like woodblock tick followed by a warm xylophone landing note.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a clock-like woodblock tick followed by a warm xylophone landing note
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Museum Dino March into a taxonomy-label walk: every exhibit label states whether the target is dinosaur, pterosaur, marine reptile, fossil part, trace, or reconstruction, replacing the fake time-machine premise.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child museum visitor reads classification labels case by case and learns that prehistoric does not equal dinosaur.
